need: Criterion-level figures, settle_cases, decision_sensitivity, options_dominance and unscoped keys (criteria.<criterion>.<arm>.value, count.failing, pass_rate, scoreboard, judged.<dim>.<arm>) read on the criterion's own aspect
why: criteria.clarity/bar/answer.correct.solo.value reads 95% (the accuracy aspect's figure) while aspects.clarity.bar.answer.correct.solo reads 60%, missed; options_dominance calls solo pass and count.failing reads 0; settle_cases sizes the clarity bar as if it clears; the unscoped scoreboard counts only the accuracy trials (38 of 40)
workaround: Cite only aspects.<aspect>.* keys; drop the clarity settle sizing; note the discrepancy in omitted

need: A block that draws an arm against an absolute bar: the bar's own value, its interval and the bar line
why: bars are not a block source and not a reference kind (margin, floor, budget); reference=floor on judged answer.correct is refused even narrowed to one aspect, because both aspects' bars read answer.correct; the judged dot_interval draws the line as a row but no interval
workaround: dot_interval over measures/passed per aspect (pass = judged correct) for the interval, the bar figure and its interval cited in prose from aspects.<aspect>.bar keys

need: small_multiples_by aspect drawing one panel per aspect
why: dot_interval over measures/passed and bars over judged/answer.clear with small_multiples_by=aspect return only the accuracy aspect's row; the clarity panel is silently dropped
workaround: one block per aspect (two evidence blocks on one claim)

need: Failed-trial examples with the reply, the judge's reason and an excerpt
why: all five frozen failures carry reason, excerpt, input and expected as none, so nothing says what the clarity-case failures look like
workaround: no examples block; reading the failed clarity trials is a next step

need: Whether two aspects ran the same cases, and a paired comparison of one arm across aspects
why: case ids overlap in form (tc-12..tc-19 under both aspects); if the cases are shared, the same case reads correct in one run and wrong in the other, which points at the judge or the run rather than the model; arms_compare takes two arms only
workaround: stated as a next step in words; no figure

need: A bar-threshold sweep that reports where a bar's status (clears, unclear, misses) flips
why: decision_sensitivity on a bar returns no_call (a bar warns and never gates), so it says nothing about where the status changes
workaround: explore outcome stated in words from the interval ends

need: The judged clarity score's scale (range, anchors) and an interval at a level
why: answer.clear is ordinal with mean and sem only, no stated range, so 4.2 vs 3.6 can't be read as good or bad
workaround: table of the score per aspect, described only relatively; a declaration is a next step

need: The pass-rate measure printed in the bar's unit and on the bar reading's interval
why: measures/passed prints 0.6 with no unit and interval 0.3866 to 0.7812, while the bar reading on the same trials prints 60% with interval 37.8-78.7%; a page carrying both shows two intervals for one figure
workaround: prose cites the bar reading; the chart caption names its figure as the pass rate; Method says the two intervals are computed separately
